usedFor: MarketProvider holds your products, HubSpot is where sales follows up, and “New Product Created” can open a deal.

bestTemplate.name: “New Product Created” in MarketProvider, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: Each new product gives sales a deal to work on, without anyone typing it in.

watchOut: “Product Is Updated” polls and fires on every update, so with “Create Deal” it can add a deal twice.
